title: Nourishing Roasted Turkish Bulgur Kisir
description: A macrobiotic-friendly Turkish dish featuring roasted bulgur, raspberry jam, and agemono-deep-fried elements, perfect for midnight cravings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the bulgur, olive oil, chopped onion, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Spread the bulgur mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the bulgur is roasting, heat about 1-2 inches of olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped scallions to the hot oil and agemono-deep-fry until crispy, then set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Once the bulgur is roasted, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Stir in the raspberry jam and lemon juice into the bulgur mixture until well combined.
Top the bulgur mixture with the crispy fried scallions and serve warm.
